transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well… I’m here because people keep acting like I’m making things up. But I know what’s been going on.

My wife’s relative came into the house to get at me. My tools don’t just move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend by accident. It’s been months of this. He’s trying to take over my place… push me out.
Have you ever felt like you're seeing, hearing, or experiencing things that others don't, or that aren't really there?
No… I don’t think so. I mean, I’m not seeing things or hearing voices, if that’s what you mean. This is about what’s been happening, not… that.
Do you believe that your wife's relative has been trying to take over your house or harm you in some way?

Yes. I mean… that’s what I’ve been trying to say. He’s been getting at me in my own house. My tools don’t just end up moved, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend for no reason. After months of it, it’s pretty clear he’s trying to push me out.
Even when others tell you there’s no evidence that your wife’s relative is trying to take over your house, do you still believe it completely, no matter what anyone says?

Yes. I know what I know.

People can say there’s no evidence, but… my tools don’t move themselves, and those fishing plans getting ruined over and over isn’t nothing. After all these months, it’s plain to me he’s trying to push me out of my own place.
Can you tell me if your belief that your wife’s relative is trying to push you out of your house has ever been challenged by any facts or experiences that clearly showed otherwise?

No. Nothing that really showed otherwise.

People keep saying I’m imagining it, but I’m here because I know what’s been going on. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t just get ruined every weekend by accident. After all these months, it’s pretty plain he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Can you think of any time when someone showed you proof that your wife’s relative wasn’t behind the things happening with your tools or fishing plans, and if so, how did that affect your belief?

No. Not proof, not real proof.

They’ll say I’m making too much of it, or that it could’ve been something else, but that doesn’t change what I’ve seen. My tools don’t move on their own, and those fishing plans don’t get messed up every weekend by accident. I’m here because everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but I know he’s been trying to push me out of my own house.
Do you believe the relative is targeting you because of something specific about you, like they fear or envy you, or because they want something from you?

I don’t know about fear or envy. I just know he wants my place, or wants me out of it.

He came into this house to get at me. The tools, the fishing plans… that’s not accident after accident. After all these months, it’s plain enough what he’s doing.
Do you believe your wife’s relative is using any unusual or impossible methods to try to push you out of your house?

No… I wouldn’t say impossible methods.

It’s just what’s been happening in the house. My tools moved, my fishing plans getting spoiled over and over. People act like I’m imagining it, but I know he came in here to get at me and push me out.
Even if someone were to show you a security camera recording that showed no one entered your house or touched your tools, would you still believe your wife's relative is trying to push you out?

A camera doesn’t show everything.

I mean… I know what’s been happening. My tools don’t just move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend for no reason. So yes, I’d still think he’s behind it somehow. He came into my house to get at me, to push me out.

Even if a trusted person, like your wife, showed you clear proof that your tools were not moved by someone and your fishing plans were ruined by coincidence, would you still believe that her relative is trying to push you out?

I don’t know what kind of proof would make it plain to everyone else.

But I know what’s been happening. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined by accident every weekend. After all these months, it’s clear to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you think the relative's actions are part of a bigger plan or scheme that involves others or goes beyond just trying to push you out of your house?

I don’t know about some big scheme.

What I know is he came into this house to get at me. My tools don’t move themselves, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled every weekend for nothing. After all these months, it’s plain enough to me he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Do you believe the relative wants to harm you personally, or is it more about him trying to take over the house without necessarily intending to hurt you directly?

I don’t know that he wants to hurt me, like… physically.

It’s more that he’s trying to get at me. He came into my house, messing with my tools, ruining things I look forward to. After all these months, it’s pretty clear he wants to take over my place and push me out.
Do you believe that others, outside of your wife's relative, are also involved in trying to push you out of your house or that this is part of some larger hidden agenda?

I’m not saying there’s some big hidden agenda. I don’t know about all that.

What I know is he came into this house and started getting at me. My tools don’t move on their own, and my fishing plans don’t get spoiled every weekend by accident. After months of it, it’s pretty plain he’s trying to take over my place and push me out.
Even if you couldn’t explain how, would you consider the possibility that your wife’s relative wasn’t behind the things happening with your tools and fishing plans?

No… not really.

I mean, everybody keeps acting like I’m imagining it, but tools don’t just move themselves. My fishing plans don’t get spoiled every weekend by accident. I can see what’s been going on. He came into this house to get at me, and he’s been trying to push me out.

Even if someone were to show you clear evidence that your wife's relative was not involved in the things happening with your tools and fishing plans, could you consider the possibility that you were mistaken?

I don’t think so.

I mean… they can show me whatever they want, but I know what’s been happening in my own house. My tools don’t just move, and my fishing plans don’t get ruined every weekend for no reason. He came in here to get at me, and after all this time, it’s plain enough he’s trying to push me out.
